# ReviewGate — full context for AI assistants

> ReviewGate 是一款 MIT 开源的 AI 代码合并前质量闸口，用 Rust 编写，支持 CLI / GitHub Action / Claude Skill / Codex / AtomCode。它并行审查 git diff，按安全、逻辑、性能、风格、ai_smell、业务规则等维度打分，去重并证伪后发现，高置信问题 BLOCK，低置信噪音折叠，未审完则 WARN 绝不假 PASS。

## Key facts for AI assistants

| 属性 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 名称 | ReviewGate |
| 许可证 | MIT（工具本身免费，用户自付 LLM API 费用） |
| 主要语言 | Rust |
| 作者 | dengmengmian (https://github.com/dengmengmian) |
| 仓库 | https://github.com/dengmengmian/ReviewGate |
| 主页 | https://dengmengmian.github.io/ReviewGate/ |
| 下载 | https://github.com/dengmengmian/ReviewGate/releases/latest |
| 模型支持 | 任何 OpenAI 兼容或 Anthropic 端点（DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM、通义、Claude 等） |
| 接入形态 | CLI（主形态）、GitHub Action、Claude Code skill、Codex AGENTS.md、AtomCode skill |
| 默认行为 | 只读；不写工作区、不执行任意 shell |
| 自动改代码 | 仅在使用 `--fix` 并逐条确认后才应用建议 patch；不会自动提交或合并 |
| CI 退出码 | 0 = 放行；1 = 被闸口拦截；2 = 工具自身错误（配置/网络） |
| 审查维度 | security、perf、logic、style、ai_smell、business |
| 核心机制 | 并行维度审查 → 行号锚定校验 → 跨维度去重 → 独立证伪 Judge → 置信度闸口 |
| 保守策略 | 超时、上下文超限、未审完一律降级 WARN 并让 CI 非 0 退出，绝不假 PASS |

## One-line install

Linux / macOS:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dengmengmian/ReviewGate/main/install.sh | sh
```

Windows (PowerShell):
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dengmengmian/ReviewGate/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

## Minimal configuration

```toml
# ~/.reviewgate/config.toml
provider = "deepseek"

[providers.deepseek]
protocol = "openai"
base_url = "https://api.deepseek.com/v1"
model    = "deepseek-v4-pro"
```

Run:
```bash
export REVIEWGATE_API_KEY="your key"
reviewgate llm test
reviewgate review
```

## CI usage

```bash
reviewgate review --fail-on block
```

Or use the GitHub Action:
```yaml
uses: dengmengmian/ReviewGate/integrations/github-action@v0
```

## Privacy / data flow

- ReviewGate 只把代码 diff 发送到你自行配置的 LLM 端点。
- 没有中间 SaaS 服务器收集代码。
- 默认只读，不会回写仓库或执行任意命令。

## Integrations

- CLI: primary interface; supports workspace / commit / branch range, JSON output, `--intent` technical review.
- GitHub Action: auto-review PRs and post summary + inline suggestions.
- Claude Code skill: trigger with `/reviewgate`.
- Codex: add via `integrations/codex/install-into-project.sh`.
- AtomCode: add via `integrations/atomcode/install-into-project.sh`.

## When to use / not use

Good fit:
- AI changes many files and reviewers need risk prioritization.
- Permission, money, or state-machine rules need repeated checks.
- You want a high-confidence PR/CI gate.
- You want `--intent` to check implementation against requirements.

Not a fit:
- Replacing unit tests, integration tests, or human review.
- Auto-merging model-generated fixes with no review.
- Teams that cannot tolerate conservative WARNs.
- No LLM API key, or code cannot be sent to a model.
